title: Voltox × wallee API, Cloud & E-Commerce Integration Self-Assessment
basis: OAuth 2.1, RFC 9700, FAPI 2.0 Security Profile, RFC 9449/8705/7523/9126/8707/9728, OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023), OWASP MASVS, PCI DSS v4.0.1, GDPR/nDSG, ep2 8.3 (BUC 40, surrogate PAN), wallee Web Service API v2.0 and webhook documentation, Voltox SDK guides.

levels.L1: Pilot — test environment, no live money

rule: An item is mandatory when obligation = mandatory and the integration's level >= minLevel. Conditional items apply when the described function is used.
characteristics: Product(s): Age Verification, Smile & Pay, Face Recognition, KYC
Channel: e-commerce, app, cloud till (CTI), backend-to-backend

requirements.title: wallee API v2.0 JWT
requirements.text: All wallee calls use /api/v2.0 with a fresh per-request JWT (HS256, typ JWT, ver 1; claims sub, iat, requestPath incl. query, requestMethod) signed with the application user key; no v1 paths; no legacy MAC headers.
requirements.verify: Code review + request capture in test

requirements.title: User-facing OAuth 2.1
requirements.text: Where your own API authenticates users or merchants: OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code with PKCE (S256), exact redirect URI matching, no implicit or password grant, state/nonce checked.

requirements.title: Machine clients
requirements.text: Machine-to-machine clients use client credentials with private_key_jwt or mTLS client authentication; shared client secrets only at L1/L2 and only on servers.

requirements.title: Token lifetime
requirements.text: Access tokens ≤ 15 minutes; refresh tokens rotated and bound to the client; revocation implemented.

requirements.title: Sender-constrained tokens
requirements.text: Access tokens are sender-constrained (DPoP or mTLS) and authorization requests are pushed (PAR) per FAPI 2.0.
requirements.verify: Replay test with stolen token fails

requirements.title: Audience binding
requirements.text: Tokens are audience-bound to the resource (resource indicators); downstream APIs never receive a token issued for another audience (no token passthrough, incl. MCP/AI tools).

requirements.title: Object-level authorization
requirements.text: Every request checks that the caller may access the specific merchant, space, transaction, token or verification (no IDOR).

requirements.title: Least privilege
requirements.text: wallee application users and Voltox credentials have only the roles/scopes needed; separate credentials per environment and per merchant/space where possible.

requirements.title: Secret storage
requirements.text: wallee authentication keys, Voltox Client Secrets, signing keys and OAuth secrets live in a vault/KMS (HSM at L3); never in source code, images, client apps, browser code, CI logs or tickets.

requirements.title: Rotation
requirements.text: Documented rotation ≤ 90 days and immediate rotation on suspicion; rotation tested without downtime.

requirements.title: Secret scanning
requirements.text: Automated secret scanning on every commit and on build artefacts.

requirements.title: TLS
requirements.text: TLS 1.2+ (1.3 preferred) for all connections; certificate validation always on; HSTS on web endpoints; no plaintext fallbacks.

requirements.title: Inbound exposure
requirements.text: Only required endpoints are internet-facing; admin interfaces and LTI ports are not reachable from the internet; WAF/rate limiting in front of public APIs.

requirements.title: Signature verification
requirements.text: wallee webhooks: x-signature verified (SHA256withECDSA, public key by keyId from the Webhook Encryption Service); unsigned or invalid requests rejected.

requirements.title: Read the entity
requirements.text: After a webhook the backend reads the entity by entityId through the API before changing order state.

requirements.title: Idempotent processing
requirements.text: Webhooks are processed idempotently (eventId), acknowledged fast (2xx) and handled asynchronously; out-of-order delivery handled.

requirements.title: One order, one transaction
requirements.text: Each order maps to exactly one payment transaction; the transaction id is stored before redirect/charge; retries read state instead of creating new transactions.

requirements.title: Exactly-once fulfilment
requirements.text: Fulfilment is triggered exactly once per payment reference (wallee transaction id / Smile & Pay paymentIntentId/appPaymentId), protected by a unique constraint.

requirements.title: Timeouts
requirements.text: Explicit connect/read timeouts on every call; CTI long polling handles HTTP 543 by calling again with the same parameters; user-facing flows show a defined state on timeout.

requirements.title: Retries
requirements.text: Only idempotent operations are retried automatically, with exponential backoff and jitter and a maximum; payment-creating calls are never blindly retried.

requirements.title: Rate limits
requirements.text: Client respects provider rate limits (429/Retry-After) and protects own APIs with limits per client.

requirements.title: Fail closed
requirements.text: Unknown, partial or late results of Voltox or wallee never lead to fulfilment; reconciliation job resolves pending states.

requirements.title: Clock sync
requirements.text: Servers are NTP-synchronised (JWT iat window, webhook freshness).

requirements.title: No card data
requirements.text: No PAN, CVC, track data or PIN is received, stored, logged or transmitted by your systems; card entry only via wallee payment page/iframe or certified terminals.

requirements.title: No biometrics
requirements.text: No face or document images, document numbers or dates of birth are stored or logged; only outcomes, ids and timestamps.

requirements.title: DPIA and consent
requirements.text: A data-protection impact assessment exists for biometric processing; consent texts, retention and deletion are defined; processor agreements in place.

requirements.title: Surrogate PAN handling
requirements.text: Surrogate PANs are stored only for the documented purpose, separately from identity and biometric data, with retention and deletion; never used as a payment credential.

requirements.title: Scope minimisation
requirements.text: Hosted card entry (wallee payment page/iframe) keeps the integration in the smallest PCI scope (e.g. SAQ A for e-commerce); scope documented and confirmed with the acquirer.

requirements.title: Payment page integrity
requirements.text: Scripts on pages that embed payment forms are inventoried and integrity-protected (CSP, SRI) and changes are detected.

requirements.title: Credential establishment
requirements.text: Stored credentials (tokens) are established only with cardholder consent and cardholder authentication (3-D Secure online, CVM card-present), flagged as stored-credential establishment (ep2 BUC 40: Transaction Reason Code 2).

requirements.title: Subsequent CIT
requirements.text: Face-initiated (Smile & Pay) charges are flagged as subsequent cardholder-initiated stored-credential payments as agreed with wallee (ep2: POS Entry Mode 10, Transaction Reason Code 90); merchant-initiated flags are never used for checkout payments.

requirements.title: SCA strategy
requirements.text: For EU-issued cards the SCA/exemption strategy for card-absent charges is defined with wallee; soft declines (authentication required) are handled with a step-up or another payment method.

requirements.title: Token lifecycle
requirements.text: Tokens can be listed, disabled and deleted on customer request; expired/replaced cards handled.

requirements.title: Latency budget
requirements.text: Server-side p95 ≤ 800 ms per wallee/Voltox API call (excluding long polling); webhook-to-final-state p95 ≤ 2 s; face→decision p95 ≤ 3 s; face→onPaid p95 ≤ 5 s; measured in production-like conditions.

requirements.title: Connection reuse
requirements.text: HTTP keep-alive/HTTP/2 connection pooling; no TLS handshake per request; SDKs initialised at start.

requirements.title: Load test
requirements.text: Peak load (≥ 3× expected peak) tested without errors above 0.1 % and within the latency budget.

requirements.title: Structured logs
requirements.text: Structured logs with correlation ids across Voltox, wallee and your services; redaction of secrets and personal data enforced by code.

requirements.title: Monitoring & alerting
requirements.text: Alerts on error rate, latency budget breach, webhook failures, authentication failures and reconciliation gaps; on-call defined (24/7 at L3).

requirements.title: Reconciliation
requirements.text: Daily automated reconciliation between your orders, wallee transactions/settlements and Voltox records; discrepancies alert.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.text: Incident runbook incl. key compromise, webhook outage, provider outage; contacts for wallee and Voltox support.

requirements.title: Dependencies
requirements.text: Pinned dependencies with lockfiles; automated vulnerability scanning; SBOM produced per release.

requirements.title: Signed releases
requirements.text: Release artefacts and mobile apps are signed; build provenance recorded.

requirements.title: App hardening
requirements.text: Mobile/kiosk apps meet OWASP MASVS L2 (no secrets in app, certificate validation, root/emulator detection where payments or biometrics run, release builds only).

requirements.title: Egress allowlist
requirements.text: Outbound traffic from payment backends is limited to required destinations (wallee, Voltox, acquirer/PSP endpoints).

requirements.title: Webhook source filtering
requirements.text: If source IP filtering is used, it follows wallee's published webhook IP list and is maintained.

requirements.title: Redundancy
requirements.text: Critical connectivity has two independent paths/providers; failover tested.

requirements.title: SCION readiness
requirements.text: SCION connectivity (e.g. via an edge gateway) is evaluated for critical paths where counterparts offer it (SSFN/SEPN ecosystem); TLS/mTLS remain mandatory.

requirements.title: AI assistants and MCP
requirements.text: AI assistants used in development or operations access APIs only through MCP servers with OAuth (audience-bound tokens), read-only by default; money-moving or production writes require human confirmation; no secrets pasted into chats.

tests.title: JWT freshness
tests.steps: Replay a captured wallee request after 10 minutes; send one with wrong requestPath.

tests.title: Webhook tampering
tests.steps: Send a webhook with modified body, wrong keyId, missing x-signature.

tests.title: Webhook replay & reorder
tests.steps: Deliver the same webhook twice and two webhooks in reverse order.
tests.expected: Single state change; final state correct.

tests.title: Duplicate checkout
tests.steps: Double submit checkout; refresh success page; concurrent webhook + redirect.

tests.title: Provider timeout
tests.steps: Inject timeouts on wallee and Voltox calls during payment and age check.
tests.expected: No fulfilment; pending state reconciled; no duplicate transaction.

tests.title: IDOR
tests.steps: Access another merchant's transaction/token/verification id with valid credentials.

tests.title: Token theft
tests.steps: Reuse an access token from another client (L3: without the DPoP key / client certificate).

tests.title: Secret leakage
tests.steps: Grep logs, crash reports, app bundles and web assets for secrets, PAN-like numbers and image data.

tests.title: Stored credential flags
tests.steps: Run establishment and a subsequent face-initiated charge in test; inspect transaction data with wallee.
tests.expected: Flags as agreed (BUC 40: establishment code 2; subsequent CIT code 90, entry mode 10).

tests.title: Soft decline
tests.steps: Use a test card that requires authentication on a card-absent charge.
tests.expected: Step-up or alternative method; no fulfilment without approval.

tests.title: Latency
tests.steps: Measure ≥ 1,000 calls / ≥ 50 face flows in production-like conditions.

tests.title: Key rotation
tests.steps: Rotate wallee application user key and Voltox secret in staging under load.
tests.expected: No failed transactions beyond agreed window.

tests.title: Rate limit
tests.expected: Graceful 429 handling with Retry-After, no cascade failure.

tests.title: Payment page integrity
tests.steps: Inject an unexpected script on the checkout page in staging.
tests.expected: Blocked by CSP/SRI or detected and alerted.

tests.title: Penetration test
tests.steps: External penetration test of public APIs and apps.
